nodes.label: Kaudra
nodes.description: Female Web Weaver seer dragon. Crystal scales glitter; scale colour, body structure and size are not established.

nodes.label: Kaudra's enormous cave
nodes.description: Huge cave containing shadowy chambers. Source does not supply an architectural floor plan.

nodes.label: Dream Chamber
nodes.description: Very large, transparent, bubble-like crystal; Dhuaar meets within; crystal shields meeting participants' thoughts from interfering vibrational chatter in Conway's account.

nodes.label: Other side chambers
nodes.description: Plural chambers collectively described as containing meditation seats, small shrines, counselor benches and thrones. No number of chambers or one-room-per-furnishing allocation supplied.

nodes.label: Empty cleansing chamber
nodes.description: An empty chamber to which Kaudra may send a student she judges ready and worthy for cleansing and opening of highest spiritual connections in Conway's system. Not Dream Chamber.

nodes.label: Dhuaar — High Council of the Multiverse
nodes.description: Discusses matters vital to Multiverse balance; specific members, number, seating and Kaudra membership not established.

nodes.label: Sacred crystal cave near the Highest gate
nodes.description: A crystal cave sacred site protected by Kaudra, near the gate to the Highest. Identity with the p43 huge cave remains unresolved.

nodes.label: Gate to the Highest
nodes.description: Gate named only as a landmark near the sacred crystal cave in p42 context. No cave entrance, physical design or Kaudra gate-guarding role established here.

nodes.label: Garden of Wisdom and Solitude
nodes.description: Garden enclosed by a high hedge; described as seemingly endless and representing many cultures. Shrines, temples, gazebos, flower-covered shelters, flowers, streams, waterfalls, fountains and small bridges over ponds; students from the Multiverse may be encountered. Placement inside cave NOT verified.

nodes.label: Misty Dream Gate
nodes.description: Misty gate that returns traveler to Upperworld near Kaudra according to p45. It is not Dream Chamber and does not specifically open into cave.

nodes.label: Web Gate
nodes.description: Gate with cobweb painting leading to the Web Weavers special side area. This route is not established as a direct cave entrance.
attributes: leads to Web Weaver side area

nodes.label: Web Weavers
nodes.description: Female seer dragons; Kaudra belongs to them, not established as their leader. Do not conflate with separate Star-Moon clan.

nodes.label: Shrine of Remembrance
nodes.realm: Otherworld sacred-site context; exact site unknown
nodes.description: Approved separate p43 sacred-site entry. Not demonstrated to be inside the huge cave or the Garden.
